themes_detail.label: Food Poisoning Outbreak Spike
themes_detail.summary: Food poisoning complaints surged to 3 THIS WEEK, a 500% spike compared to the 0.5 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 5.0), suggesting a potential localized outbreak or systemic food safety issue in East Harlem restaurants or food vendors.
evidence: 3 food poisoning complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 5.0 indicates statistically significant anomaly
Timing aligns with warm weather and peak outdoor food vendor season
reporting_angles: Interview affected residents and identify common food sources; cross-reference with DOH inspection records
Investigate whether specific restaurants, food carts, or a particular food type is driving complaints

themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Infrastructure Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket requests exploded to 3 complaints THIS WEEK, a 2300% spike versus the 0.1 weekly average (z-score: 8.69), the highest statistical anomaly in the dataset, indicating severe sanitation infrastructure gaps residents are demanding the city address.
evidence: 3 litter basket requests THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Highest z-score spike in entire dataset (8.69)
Community Board repeatedly requested 'Increase Graffiti Removal/Cleaning' funding for Department of Sanitation—unmet for multiple years
reporting_angles: Map where residents are requesting new litter baskets; analyze sanitation coverage gaps in specific blocks or neighborhoods
Interview Sanitation Dept about capacity to install baskets; examine unfunded CB budget request history

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Escalation
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged to 91 LAST WEEK, a 250% jump from the 26.0 weekly average (z-score: 4.16), representing a significant quality-of-life degradation that correlates with warm-weather construction and street activity.
evidence: 91 noise complaints LAST WEEK vs. 26.0 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
546 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (458 alterations) suggest ongoing construction activity driving noise
reporting_angles: Investigate whether construction from East 125th Street rezoning or other active ULURP projects is driving noise complaints
Interview residents about noise sources (construction, street vendors, nightlife) and enforcement response times

themes_detail.label: Drug Activity and Encampment Rise
themes_detail.summary: Drug activity complaints jumped to 9 LAST WEEK, a 279% spike from 2.4 weekly average, while encampment complaints hit 8 LAST WEEK (327% above 1.9 baseline), signaling an emerging public safety and homelessness crisis concentrated in East Harlem.
evidence: Drug activity: 9 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 2.4 weekly average (z-score: 4.2)
Encampment complaints: 8 LAST WEEK vs. 1.9 weekly average (z-score: 3.62)
Non-Emergency Police Matter complaints were 17 two weeks ago, up 209% from 5.5 baseline
reporting_angles: Identify geographic clusters of drug and encampment complaints; map against shelters, transit hubs, and parks
Interview NYPD about enforcement strategy, interview outreach organizations about capacity to serve unhoused residents

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal and Park Wildlife Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints spiked to 4 LAST WEEK (1500% above 0.2 weekly average, z-score: 8.66), while animal-in-park complaints hit 4 (357% above baseline), suggesting either an animal welfare emergency or sanitation/vector control breakdown in the district.
evidence: Dead animal complaints: 4 LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (z-score: 8.66)
Animal-in-park complaints: 4 LAST WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average (z-score: 4.0)
Community Board has standing request for 'park, building, or access improvements' funding
reporting_angles: Investigate whether a specific pest or animal population surge (rats, pigeons, wildlife) is driving complaints
Interview Parks Dept and health officials about vector control response and any disease concerns
